newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus leader to meet Chernomyrdin this week.
newsitem.headline: Belarus leader to meet Chernomyrdin this week.

text.p: President Alexander Lukashenko will meet Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin on Friday or Saturday to discuss the political crisis in Belarus, a Lukashenko aide told Reuters on Wednesday.
"They will meet on Friday or Saturday, possibly in Belarus," Ural Latypov said.
Latypov added that Lukashenko would visit the town of Brest on the Polish border about 350 km (200 miles) west of Minsk on Thursday to continue his referendum campaign.

Lukashenko earlier snubbed an invitation to attend a meeting with his main political opponent, parliamentary speaker Semyon Sharetsky, and parliamentary leaders from Russia in the Russian town of Smolensk on Wednesday.
The meeting had been scheduled by Russia to solve the political crisis in Belarus, where parliament is trying to stop Lukashenko extending his hold on power in a referendum on Sunday.
Lukashenko's closest aide, Vladimir Zametalin, told Reuters earlier that the president would not be going to Smolensk because Chernomyrdin would not be there.
